interest: Shows 1930-32 Western bankers linking Japan's loan refunding to naval treaty terms, amid the Depression and Manchurian crisis.
overview: Docket (1930-32) on Japan's finances: lifting the gold embargo, Morgan's refunding of the 1905 Sterling Loan tied to naval treaty terms, budget cuts, the Manchurian Incident's strain, Mitsui's gold speculation and cabinet collapse, leaving gold, and Hornbeck's caution against US loans to Japan.
